points.description: Names at least one image analysis application that benefits from corners, such as image segmentation, edge detection (detecting edges more efficiently), or object classification/recognition.
points.partial_credit: Only a vague mention, e.g. 'computer vision applications' without a specific application, earns half.

points.description: Gives a second application from the model answer (segmentation, edge detection, object classification) or clearly states that corners improve several image analysis/computer vision tasks.
points.partial_credit: Half if the second idea is vague or only loosely related.

rubric.notes: Give full marks for two applications of corners from the model answer (segmentation, edge detection, object classification/recognition), in any wording. Give 1 mark for one application or a vague answer like 'computer vision'. Give 0 for unrelated answers. Extra remarks, such as mentioning Harris, don't cost marks.
